properties.name: manhattan_1797
properties.map: A New & Accurate Plan of the City of New York in the State of New York in North America, published in 1797 — Benjamin Taylor, engraved by John Roberts (the Taylor-Roberts plan)
properties.georeferencing: NYPL Map Warper control points (NYC Space/Time Directory dump mapwarper.objects.ndjson, map 15327), thin-plate spline; residual = cross-validated RMS over 30 points
properties.note: Built-up = the blocks and parts of blocks the plan hatches (it leaves laid-out but empty blocks in outline and hatches a half-built block in part). The envelope keeps out the meadows, orchards and hill hachures north of the town and the plan's wharf line; the Park (the Common) is left out. East of about Rutgers St the plan was read to x = 5750 only.
properties.method: built blocks classified by tone on the warped map (tools/classify.py, parameters in tools/classify_runs.py), clipped to a hand-drawn envelope
